title.zh: 联邦团结暨领导力盛典
title.en: A Celebration of Unity and Leadership

texts.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]在我国的明智领导下繁荣昌盛。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如今感到是时候因我们为盟友提供的服务获得回报了，我们将举办一场团结盛典——更确切地说，是为向联邦无私奉献的伟大[Root.GetAdj]领袖们举办的盛典。他们提议各成员国合作在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一道丰碑，于此同时，我们将派遣代表团前往两个成员国的首都，协助他们为[Root.Federation.GetName]带来更多的凝聚力。
texts.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] has prospered under the wise leadership of our nation. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now feel that it is time for our services to the alliance to be paid back with a celebration of its unity - and more specifically, the great [Root.GetAdj] leaders that have done so much for it. They propose that member states contribute towards the erection of a grand monument in the skies above [Root.Capital.GetName], while in the meantime we send delegations to two member states' capitals to aid them in their efforts to bring greater unity to the [Root.Federation.GetName].

tooltips.zh:
所有能前往[Root.Capital.System.GetName]星系的成员国均会被邀请参与联合行动。

如果他们接受，他们必须投入资源建造纪念碑，这会增加联邦经验和[Root.GetName]的影响力。

[Root.GetName]还可以选择在两个成员国中提升[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]的吸引力。

如果这一提议遭到广泛拒绝，联邦团结度将会下降，[Root.GetName]会损失影响力。
tooltips.en:
All member states with access to the [Root.Capital.System.GetName] system will be approached to take part in the joint operation.

If they accept, they will have to dedicate resources to a monument which will boost Federation Experience and the [Root.GetName]'s Influence.

The [Root.GetName] will also be able to choose to increase [Root.GetHegemonyEthos] attraction in two member states.

If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation Cohesion will decrease and the [Root.GetName] will lose Influence.

label.en: We have no need for such trinkets.

title.zh: 联邦团结暨领导力盛典
title.en: A Celebration of Unity and Leadership

texts.zh:
你们好，尊贵的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]！在我们明智而宽宥的领导下，[Root.Federation.GetName]的实力与日俱增，我们共同目标遍及星海。是时候庆祝我们联合起来取得的成就了。还有什么会比各成员国合力在我国首都树立一座丰碑更合宜呢？与此同时，我国会派遣代表团前往贵国首都，协助你们求取[Root.Federation.GetName]的上上善道。

你们愿意加入这次活动吗？
texts.en:
Greetings, noble [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]! Under our wise and magnanimous leadership, the [Root.Federation.GetName] has gone from strength to strength, projecting our unity of purpose across the galaxy. The time has come to celebrate our joint successes as a union. What better way to do this than through a grand monument over our capital, erected through the efforts of the member states? In the meantime, we will send a delegation to your capital, which will aid your efforts to strive for the greater good of the [Root.Federation.GetName].

Will you join this venture?

tooltips.zh:
所有能前往[From.Capital.System.GetName]星系的成员国均会被邀请参与联合行动。

如果他们接受，他们必须投入资源建造纪念碑，这会增加联邦经验和[From.GetName]的影响力。

[From.GetName]还可以选择在两个成员国中提升[From.GetHegemonyEthos]的吸引力。
tooltips.en:
All member states with access to the [From.Capital.System.GetName] system will be approached to take part in the joint operation.

If they accept, they will have to dedicate resources to a monument which will boost Federation Experience and the [From.GetName]'s Influence.

The [From.GetName] will also be able to choose to increase [From.GetHegemonyEthos] attraction in two member states.

tooltips.zh: 完成纪念碑将花费[Root.GetName]£minerals£矿物年产量的10%。
tooltips.en: Completing the monument will cost 10% of the [Root.GetName]'s £minerals£ mineral output for 1 year.

label.zh: 在贵国首都树立丰碑？绝对不行！
label.en: A monument over your capital? Absolutely not!

tooltips.zh: 如果这一提议遭到广泛拒绝，联邦团结度将会下降。
tooltips.en: If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation Cohesion will decrease.

texts.zh: 我们关于举办一场联合盛典，庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的力量与团结的计划已获大多数成员国认可。我们将立刻开始致力于实施这项计划，增进联盟内的和谐。
texts.en: Our initiative to hold a joint celebration of the strength and unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has met with approval among the majority of members. We will begin work on implementing our plans to spread harmony within the alliance immediately!

tooltips.zh:
所有参与的成员国获得在[federation_leader.Capital.GetName]上建造纪念碑的特殊项目。
[federation_leader.GetName]获得特殊项目，可以向至多两个成员国传播[federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos]思潮。
tooltips.en:
All participating members gain a special project to build a monument on [federation_leader.Capital.GetName].
The [federation_leader.GetName] gains special projects to spread the [federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos] ethos to up to two member states.
The following nations rejected the plan:

title.zh: 联邦团结暨伟大领导盛典
title.en: A Celebration of Unity and Great Leadership

texts.zh: 一项联合行动已经开始，[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国将以此庆祝其强有力的领导并推动意识形态上的团结。
texts.en: A joint operation has been launched between members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] to celebrate its strong leadership and push for greater ideological unity.

texts.zh:
作为当前庆祝[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]强力领导暨意识形态团结的联合行动的一部分，代表团将被派往两个成员国的首都，以监督其更紧密地融入联盟。

一旦两个成员国已被选定，文化调整项目将被视作完成。
texts.en:
As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the strong leadership and ideological unity of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], a delegation shall be sent to two members' capitals in order to supervise their closer integration into the alliance.

Once the two member states have been chosen, the cultural adjustment program will be deemed complete.

texts.zh: 作为当前联邦联合行动的一部分，[From.Owner.GetAdj][From.Owner.GetGovernmentName]已经派出代表团前往[FromFrom.GetName]，以在[Root.GetName]宣扬[From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos]理想。尽管他们宣称这是为了在[Root.Federation.GetName]内增进和谐与善意，许多人担忧我们自己的价值观会因我们在联邦中的成员国资格受损。
texts.en: As part of the current federation joint operations, the [From.Owner.GetAdj] [From.Owner.GetGovernmentName] has sent delegates to [FromFrom.GetName] to spread [From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [Root.GetName]. Although they claim to be promoting harmony and goodwill within the [Root.Federation.GetName], many are concerned that our own values are being compromised by our membership in the alliance.

texts.zh: 作为当前联邦联合行动的一部分，[From.Owner.GetAdj][From.Owner.GetGovernmentName]已经派出代表团前往[FromFrom.GetName]，以在[Root.GetName]宣扬[From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos]理想。幸好，他们的价值观念与我们一致，相信这一定会增进[Root.Federation.GetName]内的和谐与善意。
texts.en: As part of the current federation joint operations, the [From.Owner.GetAdj] [From.Owner.GetGovernmentName] has sent delegates to [FromFrom.GetName] to spread [From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [Root.GetName]. Fortunately, their values align well with our own, lending credence to their claim to be promoting harmony and goodwill within the [Root.Federation.GetName].

label.en: Surely only good can come of this.
Surely only good can come of this.
We'll see what comes of this...

texts.zh: 我们派去[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]宣扬[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]理想的代表团已于[FromFrom.GetName]落脚。幸运的话，他们的努力会有回报，[Root.Federation.GetName]内将更为和谐。
texts.en: Our delegation to spread [Root.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] has established itself on [FromFrom.GetName]. With luck, their efforts will bear fruit and increase harmony within the [Root.Federation.GetName].

texts.zh: 由于联邦领袖的变更，旧有的歌颂[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]统治者的计划已被搁置。
texts.en: With the change in federation leadership, the old plans to glorify the rulers of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have been duly shelved.

label.en: The old king is dead; long live the king.

texts.zh: 由于我们已经脱离了旧有的联邦，在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝同盟凝聚力的计划与我们再无关联。
texts.en: As we have left our old federation, plans to construct a monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the alliance are no longer relevant to us.

texts.zh: [From.GetAdj]关于举办一场联合盛典，庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的力量与团结的计划已获大多数成员国认可。我们将立即开始工作，以便计划早日落实！
texts.en: The [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold a joint celebration of the strength and unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has met with approval among the majority of members. We will begin work to make the plans a reality immediately!

texts.zh: 尽管我国反对，[Root.Federation.GetName]中[From.GetAdj]专横的联合行动计划得到了大多数成员国的认可。幸好，[From.GetName]无法强迫我国参与这项计划。
texts.en: Despite our opposition, overbearing [From.GetAdj] plans for a joint operation in the [Root.Federation.GetName] have met with approval among the majority of members. Fortunately, there is nothing the [From.GetName] can do to force us to participate in the scheme.

texts.zh:
为了向[From.GetName]在[Root.Federation.GetName]中提供的强力领导致以敬意，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经得到成员国认可，举行一场关于联盟团结的联合庆典。成员国同意投入资源，在[From.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一座丰碑，同时[From.GetAdj]代表团将访问若干国家的首都，协助成员国融入联盟。

由于我国位置偏远，很难前往[From.Capital.GetName]，我们无法参与这一计划。
texts.en:
In honor of the strong leadership offered by the [From.GetName] in the [Root.Federation.GetName], the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have secured approval among its members for a joint celebration of our alliance's unity. Member states have agreed to dedicate resources to a grand monument in the skies above [From.Capital.GetName], while [From.GetAdj] delegations will visit various capitals to aid the integration of the member states into the alliance.

Given our remote location, with no easy access to [From.Capital.GetName], we are unable to participate in the scheme.

tooltips.zh:
所有参与的成员国获得在[federation_leader.Capital.GetName]上建造纪念碑的特殊项目。
[federation_leader.GetName]获得特殊项目，可以向至多两个成员国传播[federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos]思潮。
tooltips.en:
All participating members gain a special project to build a monument on [federation_leader.Capital.GetName].
The [federation_leader.GetName] gains special projects to spread the [federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos] ethos to up to two member states.

label.zh: 是时候在联盟内先破后立了。
label.en: Perhaps it is time to shake things up in this alliance.

tooltips.zh:
所有参与的成员国获得在[federation_leader.Capital.GetName]上建造纪念碑的特殊项目。
[federation_leader.GetName]获得特殊项目，可以向至多两个成员国传播[federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos]思潮。
tooltips.en:
All participating members gain a special project to build a monument on [federation_leader.Capital.GetName].
The [federation_leader.GetName] gains special projects to spread the [federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos] ethos to up to two member states.

label.zh: 是时候在联盟内先破后立了。
label.en: Perhaps it is time to shake things up in this alliance.

texts.zh:
为了庆贺[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]的凝聚力和实力，我们目前正在执行联合行动。作为行动的一部分，我们已经同意向[This.GetName]运送资源，以建造献给[This.Owner.GetAdj]领袖们的丰碑。

我们将为此项目献出£minerals£矿物年产量的10%。
texts.en:
As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the unity and strength of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], we have agreed to send resources to [This.GetName] for the construction of a grand monument to our [This.Owner.GetAdj] leaders.

We will have to contribute 10% of our £minerals£ mineral output for a year to this project.

texts.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明而庄严的领导的工作已经完成。揭幕式上锣鼓喧天，各成员国的星球上一片沸腾，我们纪念碑的华丽光彩清晰地映入眼帘。成员国间奋勇争先，没有任何偷工减料。最终的成果——原本献给[FromFrom.Owner.GetAdj][FromFrom.Owner.GetRulerTitle]——如今向所有人证明了我们联邦的团结与力量。
texts.en: Work has been completed on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the august and enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. It has been unveiled to much fanfare, sparking celebrations across all member worlds as the splendor of our creation became clear. Each member competed with all others to outdo them in their contribution, with none slacking off. The work - originally dedicated to the [FromFrom.Owner.GetAdj] [FromFrom.Owner.GetRulerTitle] - now stands as evidence for all to see, of the strength and togetherness of our federation.

texts.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导的工作已经完成。揭幕式上锣鼓喧天，各成员国的星球上一片沸腾，我们纪念碑的华丽光彩清晰地映入眼帘。几乎所有成员国都投入了可观的努力，最终成果是我们联盟力量与团结的典范。
texts.en: Work has been completed on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. It has been unveiled to much fanfare, sparking celebrations across member worlds as the splendor of our creation became clear. Nearly all member states gave significant contributions, making the work a fine example of our union's strength and togetherness.

texts.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导的工作已经完成。不过，我们的盟友似乎不如我们这般支持这项提案，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。
texts.en: Work has been completed on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. However, it seems that our allies did not support the initiative as strongly as we did, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

texts.zh: 我国盟友在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的“开明领导”的工作已经完成。不过，对这项提案的支持不如[FromFrom.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望的那样有力，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。
texts.en: Our allies have finished their work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the "enlightened leadership" offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. It seems that commitment to the initiative was not as strong as the [FromFrom.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] had hoped, however, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

texts.zh: 由[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提议，在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”和“开明领导”的计划今天已被正式取消。同盟中没有成员国愿意为计划做除了空话之外的贡献，也就是说这个纪念碑只算是又一个不切实际的构想——一个失败的点子，表现不出任何共同感或是力量，反而象征着我们之间的分歧。
texts.en: Plans for a monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the "enlightened leadership" offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have officially been cancelled today. Not one member of the alliance committed anything but hollow words to the initiative, meaning that the monument will go down as just another unrealized scheme - a failed idea symbolic more of our divisions than any common feeling or strength.

label.en: At least we did our part.

label.zh: 也许是时候先破后立了。
label.en: Perhaps it is time for a shake-up.

It seems that commitment to the initiative was not as strong as we had hoped, however, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

texts.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”及我们的“开明领导”的计划今天已被正式取消。同盟中没有成员国愿意为计划做除了空话之外的贡献，也就是说这个纪念碑只算是又一个不切实际的构想——一个失败的点子，表现不出任何共同感或是力量，反而象征着我们之间的分歧。

Not one member of the alliance committed anything but hollow words to the initiative, meaning that the monument will go down as just another unrealized scheme - a failed idea symbolic more of our divisions than any common feeling or strength.

label.zh: 有了我们的领导，所有人都更为强大。
label.en: Under our leadership, all are stronger.

label.en: Under our leadership, all are stronger.

label.zh: 也许依赖我们的盟友是个错误。
label.en: Perhaps we were wrong to rely on our allies.

texts.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明而庄严的领导。揭幕式上锣鼓喧天，各成员国的星球上一片沸腾，我们纪念碑的华丽光彩清晰地映入眼帘。成员国间奋勇争先，没有任何偷工减料。最终的成果——原本献给[FromFrom.Owner.GetAdj][FromFrom.Owner.GetRulerTitle]——如今向所有人证明了我们联邦的团结与力量。
texts.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the august and enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. It has been unveiled to much fanfare, sparking celebrations across all member worlds as the splendor of our creation became clear. Each member competed with all others to outdo them in their contribution, with none slacking off. The work - originally dedicated to the [FromFrom.Owner.GetAdj] [FromFrom.Owner.GetRulerTitle] - now stands as evidence for all to see, of the strength and togetherness of our federation.

texts.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。揭幕式上锣鼓喧天，各成员国的星球上一片沸腾，我们纪念碑的华丽光彩清晰地映入眼帘。几乎所有成员国都投入了可观的努力，最终成果是我们联盟力量与团结的典范。
texts.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. It has been unveiled to much fanfare, sparking celebrations across member worlds as the splendor of our creation became clear. Nearly all member states gave significant contributions, making the work a fine example of our union's strength and togetherness.

texts.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。不过，我们的盟友似乎不如我们这般支持这项提案，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。
texts.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. However, it seems that our allies did not support the initiative as strongly as we did, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

label.en: At least we did our part.

texts.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结及[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。他们对我们的付出表示感谢，但在纪念碑正式揭幕前尚需等待我们的联邦盟友完成贡献。
texts.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName], celebrating the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. They thank us for our offering, although they await the contributions of our federation allies before the monument is officially unveiled.

tooltips.zh: 在所有成员国贡献完成后，联邦将收到经验增益。
tooltips.en: Once all members have completed their contributions, the Federation will gain an experience boost.

texts.zh: 由于[FromFrom.GetName]不再是我们联邦的中心，旧有的歌颂该行星统治者的计划已经搁置。
texts.en: As [FromFrom.GetName] is no longer the center of our federation, the old plans to glorify the planet's rulers have been duly shelved.

texts.zh: 尽管有我们为[From.GetAdj]举办[Root.Federation.GetName]团结盛典的提议背书，这项计划似乎还是失败了。失败原因是其他成员国不愿提供足够支持。
texts.en: Despite our backing for the [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold a celebration of the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s unity, it seems that the plan has fallen through. There was simply not enough support for it among the other member states.

texts.zh: 我们对[Root.Federation.GetName]中[From.GetAdj]专横的联合行动计划的反对有了成效。震惊于这项计划打算在成员国间播撒[From.GetAdj]宣传，这项提议被各方广泛回绝。
texts.en: Our opposition to the overbearing [From.GetAdj] plans for a joint operation in the [Root.Federation.GetName] has borne fruit. Appalled at the plans for missions to spread [From.GetAdj] propaganda among the member states, the proposals were roundly rejected by all parties.

label.zh: 是时候在联盟内先破后立了。
label.en: Perhaps it is time to shake things up in this alliance.

texts.zh: 我国大使就我国的团结盛典计划与[Root.Federation.GetName]各成员国进行了商洽。不幸的是，他们对这件事的看法似乎与我们不同，我们没能获得计划推进所必需的支持。
texts.en: Our ambassadors have approached the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] with our plans for a celebration of unity. Unfortunately, it seems that they do not feel the same way about the matter as we do, and we have been unable to muster sufficient support for the plan to proceed.

label.zh: 他们如此缺乏信念，令人不安。
